finam.authentication: POST /v1/sessions with secret; bearer JWT; POST /v1/sessions/details for accounts
finam.bar_timestamp_semantics: UNVALIDATED: REST/gRPC schema describes a timestamp but does not establish boundary meaning, H1 phase, or availability
finam.documentation_retrieval: https://api.finam.ru/docs/rest/ and OpenAPI endpoints attempted 2026-10-01; HTTP CONNECT 403 in build environment; exact account/margin schema supplied as task authority and pending credential-backed confirmation
finam.pagination: no request token documented; none sent

schema_authority.account: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}: equity is a REST Decimal value object; portfolio is a oneof; UNION requires portfolio_mc while supported FORTS accounts require portfolio_forts
schema_authority.account_asset: GET /v1/assets/{symbol}?account_id: quote_currency string, decimals integer, min_step decimal string mantissa, lot_size {value: decimal string}, future_details.contract_size {value: decimal string}

account_rest_decimal.currency: not embedded in these Decimal wrappers

schema_authority.available_cash_semantics: the account-type-consistent portfolio available_cash is capacity authority; MC account margins and FORTS money_reserved are evidence and are not subtracted; unknown or mismatched shapes fail closed
schema_authority.generic_assets: GET /v1/assets discovery fields: ticker, symbol=ticker@mic, mic, id, type, is_archived
schema_authority.params: GET /v1/assets/{symbol}/params?account_id: primitive boolean is_tradable and decimal string trade_lot_size
schema_authority.quantity: Order quantity.value is asset units; one MOEX futures asset unit is one contract and must respect trade_lot_size
schema_authority.rest_transport_rule: REST shapes are authoritative; protobuf/gRPC {num,scale} Decimal and wrapped BoolValue are rejected by production binding
